notes: Technical report on HelpSteer2-Preference data and reward/RLHF training, not a safety system card. Per pilot rules, skipped RewardBench entirely (reward-model/judge benchmark), including its Safety column. Skipped capability/chat-preference evals: MT-Bench, AlpacaEval 2.0 LC, Arena Hard, and Table 13 MMLU/GSM8K/HumanEval. Appendix D sycophantic/style factors describe annotator preference justifications, not model sycophancy tests. Ethics statement covers training-data filtering only, so topics stay uncovered. Released HF ids named: nvidia/Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B-Instruct (seed checkpoint) and Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B-Reward (seed has Reward-HF, not exact match). Scale AI is an annotation vendor, not an external safety tester.
